headlines.title: 业内专家：未来应主要通过利率来观察信贷供需匹配情况
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行8月14日发布的数据显示，7月份企业新发放贷款加权平均利率略低于3.0%，比上年同期低约0.2个百分点。专家表示，未来应主要通过利率来观察信贷供需匹配情况。近年来，我国贯彻新发展理念、推动高质量发展取得积极成效，产业结构深度调整，增长动能新旧转换，信贷供需形势反映了经济结构转型。信贷和其他商品一样，应以满足人民群众生产生活需要为宜，不需要过多关注规模增长。我国M2占GDP比重已经不低，信贷供给能够满足实体经济融资需求。未来要淡化对信贷规模的关注，更多关注价格，即市场利率的变化。(中证金牛座)

headlines.title_en: Industry experts: In the future, credit supply-demand matching should mainly be observed through interest rates
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the People's Bank of China on August 14 showed that in July, the weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans was slightly below 3.0%, about 0.2 percentage points lower than the same period last year. Experts said that in the future, interest rates should be the main gauge for observing the matching of credit supply and demand. In recent years, China has achieved positive results in implementing its new development philosophy and promoting high-quality development, with deep industrial structural adjustments and a shift in growth drivers, and the credit supply-demand situation reflects the economic structural transformation. Like other commodities, credit should primarily meet the production and living needs of the people, and excessive focus on scale growth is unnecessary. China's M2 as a share of GDP is already not low, and credit supply is sufficient to meet the financing needs of the real economy. Going forward, attention should shift away from credit scale and toward prices, i.e., changes in market interest rates. (China Securities Journal Jin Niu)

headlines.title: 央行等两部门：决定在全国范围内推广跨国公司本外币跨境资金集中运营业务

headlines.title_en: Two central bank departments: Decide to roll out cross-border centralized operation of local and foreign currency funds for multinational companies nationwide
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange have decided to promote centralized cross-border foreign exchange fund management operations for multinational corporations nationwide. The total cross-border current account receipts and payments in local and foreign currencies of all domestic member enterprises in the previous year must be no less than RMB 700 million equivalent; alternatively, the total operating revenue of all domestic member enterprises in the previous year must be no less than RMB 1 billion equivalent, and the total operating revenue of all overseas member enterprises in the previous year must be no less than RMB 200 million equivalent.

headlines.title_en: PBOC: RMB deposits increased by 17.79 trillion yuan in the first seven months
headlines.summary_en: PBOC: At the end of July, deposits in local and foreign currencies totaled 354.49 trillion yuan, up 8.1% year on year. RMB deposits at the end of the month stood at 346.47 trillion yuan, up 8.1% year on year. RMB deposits increased by 17.79 trillion yuan in the first seven months. Among them, household deposits increased by 6.95 trillion yuan, non-financial corporate deposits increased by 1.57 trillion yuan, fiscal deposits increased by 1.95 trillion yuan, and deposits of non-banking financial institutions increased by 5.76 trillion yuan. At the end of July, foreign currency deposits stood at $1.18 trillion, up 17.9% year on year. In the first seven months, foreign currency deposits increased by $121.2 billion.

headlines.title_en: Industry experts: Objectively view the relationship between M2 growth, social financing growth, loan growth, and deposit growth
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 14 - Regarding the market-concerned issue of idle funds circulating within the financial system, industry experts said that M2 and total social financing are two different statistical indicators with differences in statistical calibers. It is normal for one to grow faster than the other, and there is no clear policy implication. Whether funds are idle in the banking system cannot be judged by comparing M2 growth with social financing growth. In addition, regarding deposit growth versus loan growth, experts said that in the context of diversified financing structures, deposit growth outpacing loan growth is a normal phenomenon. In earlier years, loan issuance was the main channel for deposit creation, and deposit and loan growth rates were relatively close. In recent years, with the development of financial markets, the loan channel has been increasingly replaced by other creation channels such as bonds in the process of deposit creation. headlines.title_en: Two departments: Support small and medium-scale multinational companies in conducting business in a broader scope
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange issued the Notice on Matters Concerning Centralized Cross-Border Foreign Exchange Fund Management Operations for Multinational Corporations. The contents of the Notice include: first, supporting small and medium-sized multinational corporations in conducting business on a wider scale. The pilot policy for centralized cross-border foreign exchange fund management for multinational corporations will be extended nationwide, benefiting more market entities. If the lead enterprise is registered in a free trade zone, the threshold for establishing a fund pool can be further lowered, continuously releasing policy dividends.

headlines.title: 受助AI相关电子产品需求旺盛 中国香港上修今年GDP增长预测
headlines.summary: 中国香港政府周五称，将2026年本地生产总值增长预测上修至3.5-4.5%，原预测为2.5-3.5%。中国香港政府经济顾问范婉儿表示，香港经济在今年下半年应可见稳健增长。全球对人工智能相关电子产品的需求旺盛，料会继续支持香港的商品贸易表现，相关物流服务亦应受惠于此良好势头。今天公布的修订数字显示，香港第二季GDP按年涨4.3%，按季则跌0.6%，与此前的预估数字一致。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong revises up this year's GDP growth forecast on strong AI-related electronics demand
headlines.summary_en: The Hong Kong government said on Friday that it has revised its 2026 GDP growth forecast upward to 3.5-4.5%, from an original forecast of 2.5-3.5%. Hong Kong government economic advisor Vanora Fan said Hong Kong's economy should see steady growth in the second half of this year. Strong global demand for AI-related electronic products is expected to continue supporting Hong Kong's merchandise trade performance, and related logistics services should also benefit from this momentum. The revised figures released today show that Hong Kong's second-quarter GDP grew 4.3% year on year and fell 0.6% quarter on quarter, consistent with previous estimates.

headlines.summary: 中国证监会组织专门力量抽样审阅了上市公司2025年年度财务报告，在此基础上形成了《上市公司2025年年度财务报告会计监管报告》。总体而言，上市公司能够较好地理解并执行企业会计准则和财务信息披露规则，但仍有部分上市公司在收入、金融工具、长期股权投资与企业合并、资产减值、研发支出等方面，存在会计处理或财务信息披露错误。

headlines.title_en: CSRC releases 2025 annual financial reporting accounting supervision report for listed companies
headlines.summary_en: CSRC organized dedicated teams to sample-review listed companies' 2025 annual financial reports, forming the '2025 Annual Financial Report Accounting Supervision Report for Listed Companies'. Overall, listed companies have properly understood and applied corporate accounting standards and financial disclosure rules, but some still have errors in accounting treatment or financial disclosure regarding revenue, financial instruments, long-term equity investments and business combinations, asset impairment, and R&D expenditure.

headlines.title: 7月贷款利率保持低位水平
headlines.summary: 今年以来，我国贷款利率保持低位水平，7月延续下行态势。7月份，企业新发放贷款加权平均利率略低于3%，比上年同期低约0.2个百分点；个人住房新发放贷款加权平均利率约3.1%，与上年同期基本持平。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Lending rates remained at low levels in July
headlines.summary_en: Since the start of this year, lending rates in China have remained low, continuing their downward trend in July. In July, the weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans was slightly below 3%, about 0.2 percentage points lower than the same period last year. The weighted average interest rate on new personal housing loans was around 3.1%, roughly unchanged from a year earlier. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 广东省首个词元经济专项金融产品“Token贷”在广州海珠发布
headlines.summary: 广东省首个词元经济专项金融产品“Token贷”在广州海珠区发布。以中国银行广州分行为例，针对海珠算力中小微企业针对性研发专属融资产品——算力Token贷，按合同/Token消耗额度核定额度，可提供信用、应收账款质押、订单融资为主的担保方式，亦可组合保证、抵押等组合担保，进一步扩大额度。新公司亦可在原经营企业提供连续经营佐证材料、或提供担保的情况下按订单申请融资。据悉，中国银行前期试单授信资金已达2800万元。（界面）

headlines.title_en: Guangdong's first Token-specific financial product, 'Token Loan,' launched in Guangzhou's Haizhu district
headlines.summary_en: Guangdong's first token-economy specialized financial product, 'Token Loan,' was launched in Guangzhou's Haizhu District. For example, Bank of China Guangzhou Branch has developed a dedicated financing product, Computing Power Token Loan, for small and medium-sized computing enterprises in Haizhu. Loan quotas are set based on contract/Token consumption limits, with guarantees primarily in the form of credit, accounts receivable pledge, and order financing, which can be combined with sureties or mortgages to expand capacity. New companies can also apply for financing based on orders if they provide proof of continuous operations from an existing business or offer a guarantee. It is reported that Bank of China's initial pilot credit funds have reached 28 million yuan. (Interface)
